content:
I specialise in providing tailored UX product design and responsive web development services for clients to solve their real-world problems, and increase productivity, sales and intelligence.
In my freelance career, I provide design services to clients, building user-centric websites, e-commerce platforms, and various web applications that solve real-world problems and create value for them.
Let me show you the rough outline of my design services.
Discovery and strategy
Before any project starts, it is important to understand requirements, identify user needs, formulate product strategy, and determine project scope.

  • Proof of concept
    • Have a conversation with stakeholders, especially client representative to understand their problems and requirements, to design products that users love.
  • Proto-persona
    • Quick representations of user types based on initial hypothesis to identify target users, their needs, pain points, and goals.
  • Competitor Analysis
    • In-depth research and analysis to find out the strength and weakness among your company and competitors, formulate product design strategy to identify essential features and untapped opportunities in the market.
  • UX audit and redesign
    • A comprehensive evaluation of your existing products to assess alignment with business objectives, accessibility, usability, to improve user experience.
  • Information architecture
    • The map of content, navigation systems, hierarchy, and user flows for your products, ensuring users can easily find and interact with that they need.
UX/UI/Product design
During the design phase, we will begin to determine the framework and look and feel of the product design in preparation for the development phase.

  • Wireframe
    • Picturing the product skeleton and layout in a low-fidelity way for communication and design improvement.
  • Engineering-oriented design system
    • A complete product UI kit includes design specifications, reusable components, and documentation for collaboration with engineers.
Application Development
After everything is set, the next step is to bring design to the real world, as a UX developer, I will choose to utilize full-stack development technologies to create an interactable product, present the result to every user.

  • Responsive UI
    • Regardless of what device users use, they deserve a consistent user experience.
  • Accessibility design
    • Creating inclusive and user-friendly product design for people with disabilities is crucial, it is not just about complying with the laws, but to expand your user base and improve business reputation.
  • Heuristic evaluation
    • Running heuristic evaluation before launch is an important part, to ensure that product meets usability principle in the early stage of design.
  • Handoff
    • When design is finished, I will deliver the source codes and docs of project for handoff, to ensure the subsequent work can smoothly continue.
Continuous iteration
Handoff might mean the end of the entire project, however, for companies, the launch of website and application is just a new beginning of challenge, they must always pay attention to how users think and what they do, I offer services to help companies with continuous iteration and data-driven design to optimize the design of websites and applications, increase product conversion rate, retention rate, referral rate, ultimately turn user experience into continuous revenue.

  • A/B testing
    • A part of data-driven design, it involves comparing 2 or more design version to see which performs better, it is also helpful for companies to understand user behaviour, improve engagement, ultimately boosts metrics such as conversion rate, retention rate, and revenue
  • Survey
    • Surveys is a methodology to understand user needs and preferences, they provide valuable insights into what users like, dislike, and struggle with and they are good for product design improvement and better user experience delivery which is crucial to business.
  • Usability testing
    • Conducting usability testing is to help companies assess if the product is easy to use and ensuring that users can complete tasks effectively and enjoyably. Through observation and interaction with real users, problems in product design can be identified and addressed, improving user satisfaction and loyalty, and ultimately increasing the success rate for companies.
  • Contextual inquiry
    • Through mid-term and long-term remote field study, we can observe users' actual usage environments and scenarios for the product, to gain a deeper understanding of user behaviour, requirements, and pain points.
